boundaries.arithmetic: FP64 baseline; actual FP32 execution/refinement belongs to #174 instrumentation
boundaries.calibration: limited CPU FP64 domain; never a certified observable bound
boundaries.fixed_density_audit: CPU native raw values plus NumPy contractions, timed separately
boundaries.model_variation: changing fitting metric/grid/provider changes model identity and is rejected by the accuracy assessment
boundaries.relaxed_audit: separate strict native solve, validated against pinned independent PySCF
boundaries.screening: CPU oracle is unscreened; no CPU screening speed/error claim

conventions.auxiliary_centers: explicit independent identities and parent atom indices; [] means none
conventions.cartesian_normalization: each contracted Cartesian component has unit self-overlap
conventions.cartesian_order: descending lx, then descending ly; lz=l-lx-ly
conventions.derivative_order: shell-center slot, xyz, i,j,k,l; nuclear-center derivative
conventions.eri_storage: C order, last AO index fastest
conventions.nuclear_charges: explicit atomic_numbers, never inferred from basis labels
conventions.orbital_order: ascending canonical orbital energy within each spin
conventions.orbital_phase: largest-absolute AO coefficient positive; first index wins ties; no degenerate-subspace rotation
conventions.orbital_representation: real spatial orbitals; alpha/beta separate for UHF
conventions.spherical_order: libcint real harmonics; p=(x,y,z); l>=2 m=-l,...,+l
conventions.spin_orbital_order: when expanded: all alpha spatial orbitals, then all beta
